name: Epic Ring of the Mire
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Ring of the Mire

effects.name: Spearblock
effects.tooltip: Spearblock X : Passive: Reduces physical damage taken by 20, except from Bludgeoning or Slashing weapons. (Damage Reduction: 20/Slash, Bludgeon)

effects.name: Resistance
effects.tooltip: Resistance +8 : Passive: +8 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

effects.name: Feather Falling
effects.tooltip: Feather Falling : This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.

effects.name: Improved Earthen Guard
effects.tooltip: Improved Earthen Guard : When you are successfully attacked, there is a 15% chance that a Stone Skin will be cast on you.

effects.name: Epic Marshwalker
effects.tooltip: Epic Marshwalker : 2 Pieces Equipped: +30% Enhancement bonus to movement speed +3 Artifact bonus to all Saving Throws +5 Artifact bonus to Jump and Tumble

flavor_text: This ring was crafted to ease travel through thick, overgrown marsh territory.

source.raw: Epic version of Ring of the Mire
